resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Hindi source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Hindi pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, and technical-clarity defects across electrical, circuit, trigonometric, thermal, and TCR content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Hindi human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Joule worked formula localized protected variables and the watt unit.
evidence: The previous expression used Devanagari variable names and a localized unit spelling.

findings.summary: The Joule energy formula localized protected variables, time, and joule notation.
evidence: The previous expression used Hindi words for E, P, t, seconds, and joules.
findings.resolution: Restored E = P × t = 7.2 W × 10 s = 72 J.

findings.summary: The Joule example described power as a rate of joules rather than identifying the watt value clearly.
evidence: The previous conclusion used a literal joules-per-second phrasing.
findings.resolution: Clarified the result as 7.2 W and 72 J in 10 seconds.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet retained an English loanword for hardware.
evidence: The previous bullet used हार्डवेयर in otherwise Hindi technical prose.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Hindi term उपकरण.

findings.summary: The practical-safety paragraph used a literal headroom phrase and an inconsistent current term.
evidence: The previous paragraph referred to हेडरूम and mixed current terminology.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with पर्याप्त सुरक्षा-मार्जिन and consistent धारा wording.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms title was a literal phrase rather than natural Hindi technical terminology.
evidence: The previous title was सर्किट शर्तें.
findings.resolution: Changed it to परिपथ की शब्दावली.

findings.summary: The node definition used an awkward literal translation for an intervening component.
evidence: The previous definition used हस्तक्षेपकारी घटक, which is unnatural in this circuit context.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the definition as connected conductors with no component between them.

findings.summary: The branch definition used a generic current phrase instead of the standard धारा terminology.
evidence: The previous bullet described a branch as a वर्तमान पथ.
findings.resolution: Changed it to धारा का एक पथ.
